records.text: Magistrate Barthilas is a worried civic figure in plague-stricken Stratholme. He fears that illness, ineffective remedies, and rumors about poisoned food will turn neighbors against one another and plunge the city into bedlam. Feeling ill himself, he wonders whether stress is causing ulcers and feels powerless to help.
